sources.title: Home - BeneSys
sources.snippet: BeneSys is a team of dedicated Taft-Hartley Trust Fund Specialists. We have served Taft-Hartley Trust Funds and their plan participants for over 45 years and understand the nuances of Taft-Hartley benefit plans.

sources.title: Provider Portal - BeneSys
sources.snippet: Click the Provider Portal Instructions button to download a detailed user guide to help you navigate the BeneSys Provider Portal. This PDF includes instructions on how to search for a patient, view their claims and eligibility details, download benefit plan documents, submit secure inquiries, update your account information, and more!
